description_en: Creates a job for a cluster
description_zh: 为指定集群创建一个作业
name: CreateJob

parameters.help_en:
The cluster ID.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87116.html operation to query the cluster ID
parameters.help_zh:
集群ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87116.html获取集群ID
parameters.name: cluster_id

fields.help_en:
The jobs in the queue.

Format: X-Y:Z. X is the minimum index value. Y is the maximum index value. Z is the step size. For example, 2-7:2 indicates that three jobs need to be run and their index values are 2, 4, and 6
fields.help_zh:
数组作业参数。

格式为X-Y:Z， 最小值X是第一个索引，最大值Y是最后一个索引，Z表示步长，例如2-7:2，表示作业队列包含编号为2、4、6的3个子作业
fields.name: array_request

fields.help_en:
The command or script that is used to run the job. If you want to use a command, you must specify the full path of the command, for example, /bin/ping.

If you want to use a script, you must make sure that you have the execution permissions on it. By default, the user root directory ~/ is used as the default script path on the cluster side. If your script is not in that directory, you must specify the full path in this parameter, such as /home/xxx/job.sh Note that in this mode, if requirements on resources such as CPU and memory are specified in the script, the job will be run based on the resource requirements specified in the script. In this case, do not specify resource requirements in the Resource parameter. Otherwise, the job may fail to run.

If you want to run the job directly by using the CLI, you must specify the absolute path of the command and add two hyphens and a space (-- ) before the path, such as -- /bin/ping -c 10 localhost
fields.help_zh:
作业运行命令或脚本，如果是命令，需指定命令完整路径，如: /bin/ping；

如果希望通过脚本运行作业，则对应脚本需要有可执行权限。集群侧默认以用户根目录作为脚本默认路径，即~/目录。如您的脚本不在该目录下，需在该参数中指定完整路径，如：/home/xxx/job.sh。请注意在这种方式下，如果脚本中指定了CPU、内存等资源需求，作业将以脚本中指定的资源为准，请不要在Resource参数中指定相关资源需求，否则作业可能运行失败。

如果希望直接通过命令行命令运行作业，则需要指定命令的绝对路径，并在前面添加--，如：-- /bin/ping -c 10 localhost
fields.name: command_line

fields.help_en: The queue to which the job belongs
fields.name: job_queue

fields.help_en: The post-processing command of the job
fields.name: post_cmd_line

fields.help_en: The number of vCPUs to be allocated to each compute node
fields.help_zh: 作业每个计算节点需要分配的CPU核数
fields.name: cores

fields.help_en: The number of GPUs to be allocated to each compute node
fields.help_zh: 作业每个计算节点需要分配的GPU数
fields.name: gpus

fields.help_en: The memory size to be allocated to each compute node. The memory size is in string format. Unit: MB or GB
fields.help_zh: 作业每个计算节点需要分配的内存大小，字符串格式，包含单位，mb(M字节)或gb（千兆字节）
fields.name: memory

fields.help_en: The number of compute nodes to be allocated to the job
fields.help_zh: 作业需要分配的计算节点数
fields.name: nodes

fields.help_en: The resource configurations of the job
fields.name: resources

fields.help_en: The cluster-side user as which you want to submit the job
fields.help_zh: 提交作业所使用的用户，该用户属于集群侧用户
fields.name: runas_user

fields.help_en: The password of the user specified by the RunasUser parameter
fields.help_zh: RunasUser参数所指定用户的密码
fields.name: runas_user_password

fields.help_en: The path of the standard error output file of the job. You need to specify the full path
fields.help_zh: 作业标准错误输出文件，需要指定完整路径
fields.name: stderr_path

fields.help_en: The path of the standard output file of the job. You need to specify the full path
fields.help_zh: 作业标准输出文件，需要指定完整路径
fields.name: stdout_path

fields.help_en: The environment variables of the job. The value is a string in the JSON array format. Each array member is a JSON object that contains two members: Name and Value. Name indicates the name of the environment variable, and Value indicates the value of the environment variable
fields.help_zh: 作业的环境变量。json数组格式的字符串，每个数组成员为json格式对象，包含Name和Value两个成员，Name表示环境变量的名称，Value表示环境变量的值
fields.name: variables

fields.help_en: The maximum duration for which the job can be run. Format: `hour: minute: second`. For example, `01:00:00` indicates 1 hour
fields.help_zh: 作业最大运行时间，格式为`小时:分钟:秒`，例如`01:00:00`表示1小时
fields.name: wall_time

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful
